properties.content: Question: covid 19 sideeffects Answer: Common Side Effects of COVID-19 Infection: fever, cough, fatigue, shortness of breath, muscle aches, headache, sore throat, loss of taste or smell, diarrhea, and nausea. Less Common but Serious Side Effects:: - Pneumonia - Acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS) - Multisystem inflammatory syndrome in children (MIS-C) - Blood clots - Heart inflammation - Stroke - Kidney failure Long-Term Effects (Post-COVID-19 Syndrome):: - Fatigue - Brain fog - Lung problems - Heart problems - Mental health issues - Autoimmune disorders - Multi-organ dysfunction Note: The severity and duration of side effects can vary widely depending on the individual's age, overall health, and the severity of their infection. Some people may experience only mild symptoms, while others may develop severe complications. It is important to seek medical attention if you experience any concerning symptoms.
properties.formattedContent:
Question: covid 19 sideeffects

Answer: Common Side Effects of COVID-19 Infection:
fever, cough, fatigue, shortness of breath, muscle aches, headache, sore throat, loss of taste or smell, diarrhea, and nausea.
Less Common but Serious Side Effects::
- Pneumonia
- Acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS)
- Multisystem inflammatory syndrome in children (MIS-C)
- Blood clots
- Heart inflammation
- Stroke
- Kidney failure
Long-Term Effects (Post-COVID-19 Syndrome)::
- Fatigue
- Brain fog
- Lung problems
- Heart problems
- Mental health issues
- Autoimmune disorders
- Multi-organ dysfunction
Note: The severity and duration of side effects can vary widely depending on the individual's age, overall health, and the severity of their infection. Some people may experience only mild symptoms, while others may develop severe complications. It is important to seek medical attention if you experience any concerning symptoms.
